title: Generic response adapter pipeline + resilient stream iterator for Go SDK
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a schema-driven, generics-first response adapter pipeline for the Go SDK that produces typed structs from streaming and non-streaming LLM responses. Add a ResilientStreamIterator that can resume from transient errors, maintain ordering guarantees for partial structured outputs, and expose a backpressure-friendly read interface for servers and client apps. The goal is to provide ergonomics parity with our TS/Python SDKs while preserving low-latency token streaming and supporting structured output contracts.
acceptance_criteria: New generic adapter types (Adapter[T]) implemented and covered by unit tests
ResilientStreamIterator API reviewed and merged: Next(ctx) (T, error) with built-in retry/backoff and kv-prefix resume
Benchmarks show <=5% median latency regression for small payloads compared to current streaming path and improved p99 stability under load
Migration guide & code samples added to Go SDK README and examples folder
End-to-end contract tests validate schema coercion, unknown-field handling, and graceful degradation to raw envelope
One internal customer (console rollouts) uses the new iterator in staging with no regressions after 2 days of smoke testing
technical_notes: Design: expose Adapter[T] where T is a user-defined struct; pipeline composes: preprocessor -> tokenizer-agnostic envelope parser -> schema mapper -> post-processor
Retry model: idempotent resume only for append-only token streams using prefix id and resume offset. For non-resumable endpoints, fall back to transparent re-request + dedupe in client library
Memory: iterator keeps a small ring buffer of unconsumed partial results to avoid duplicating KV cache state; target mem < 1MB per stream for common chat workloads
Generics constraints: use Go 1.21+ friendly syntax; provide non-generic thin wrappers for older callers to minimize migration friction
Compatibility: keep current synchronous Decode* helpers but mark them deprecated in favor of Adapter pipeline
Failure modes documented: partial-struct parse error -> emit structured 'ParseError' envelope with original text, preserve stream position for retry
migration_plan: Phase 1 (canary): land internal-only Adapter types behind feature flag and wire into examples used by platform QA
Phase 2: update high-impact internal services (console rollouts, billing summaries) to use ResilientStreamIterator in staging
Phase 3: opt-in beta release to external customers with docs and example PRs
Phase 4: deprecate old helpers in next minor release after 4 weeks of stable telemetry
qa_plan: Unit tests for Adapter[T] map/flatMap semantics and null/unknown field handling
Fuzz tests for envelope parser with truncated and interleaved token chunks
Load tests with concurrent 5000 active streams on CI instance to validate p99 backlog and backpressure heuristics
Contract tests against golden prompt sets (see links) to detect regression in structured outputs
Manual exploratory test: simulate transient gRPC termination and resume behavior with recorded offsets
